fields.label: Tipas
fields.description: Pasirenkama medija, rodoma virš klausimo.

fields.label: Užuomina
fields.description: Užuomina, kuri turėtų nurodyti atsakymą.

fields.label: Atsakymas
fields.description: Atsakymas į užuominą.

fields.label: Pataisyti žodį tinklelyje
fields.description: Pažymėkite, ar norite pataisyti žodį tam tikroje tinklelio vietoje. Žodžiai, kurių lygiavimas yra toks pat, negali būti dedami liečiant vienas kitą.

fields.label: Eilutė
fields.description: Eilutės indeksas, kur turėtų prasidėti atsakymas.

fields.label: Stulpelis
fields.description: Stulpelio indeksas, kur turėtų prasidėti atsakymas.

fields.label: Padėtis
fields.description: Padėtis atsakymui.

semantics.label: Bendras sprendimo žodis
semantics.description: Pasirinktinai pridėkite sprendimo žodį, kurį galima išvesti iš tam tikrų tinklelyje esančių simbolių. Jis bus matomas tik tuo atveju, jei kryžiažodyje bus rasti visi jo simboliai. Atminkite: šiai funkcijai pritaikymo palaikymo dar nėra.

fields.label: Nustatykite tinkintus atsiliepimus bet kokiam balų diapazonui
fields.description: Spustelėkite mygtuką „Pridėti diapazoną“, kad pridėtumėte tiek diapazonų, kiek jums reikia. Pavyzdys: 0–20 % blogas balas, 21–91 % vidutinis balas, 91–100 % puikus rezultatas!

fields.label: Text alignment
fields.description: Only used when no feedback image is set. With an image, text alignment follows image position (left/right: left aligned, above: centered).

fields.label: Grid background
fields.description: Background of the crossword grid itself.

fields.label: Fono paveikslėlis
fields.description: Select an optional background image. It will be scaled to fit the background without stretching it.

fields.label: Fono spalva
fields.description: Choose a background color. It will either be used instead of a background image or as background for transparent areas.

fields.label: Cells
fields.description: Colors of the grid lines and the cells.

fields.label: Tinklelio spalva
fields.description: Pasirinkite tinklelio spalvą.

fields.label: Langelio fono spalva
fields.description: Pasirinkite lentelės langelio fono spalvą.

fields.label: Langelio teksto spalva
fields.description: Pasirinkite lentelės langelio teksto spalvą.

fields.label: Užuominos id spalva
fields.description: Pasirinkite užuominos ID spalvą lentelės langelyje.

fields.label: Border thickness
fields.description: Thickness of the cell borders in hundredths of an em, so it scales with the grid.

fields.label: Show outer border
fields.description: Draw the border around the whole grid.

fields.label: Hide borders of empty cells
fields.description: Leaves the cells without a letter without border, so the grid looks like it is floating.

fields.label: Highlighted cells
fields.description: Colors used for the cells of the clue that is currently selected.

fields.label: Langelio fono spalva (paryškinta)
fields.description: Pasirinkite paryškinto lentelės langelio fono spalvą.

fields.label: Langelio teksto spalva (paryškinta)
fields.description: Pasirinkite paryškinto lentelės langelio teksto spalvą.

fields.label: Langelio ID spalva (paryškinta)
fields.description: Choose the color of the clue id inside a table cell that is highlighted.

fields.label: Focused cell border color
fields.description: Border color of the cell the cursor is on.

fields.label: Show glow around the focused cell
fields.description: Turn it off to keep only the border of the focused cell.

fields.label: Activity area
fields.description: Background behind the grid and the clue list. It does not change the grid background.

fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.label: Clue list text
fields.description: Typography of the clue list next to the grid.

fields.label: Group title color
fields.description: Color of the "Across" and "Down" headings.

fields.label: Clue text scale
fields.description: Multiplies the automatic font size. 1 keeps the current size.

fields.label: Action buttons (Check, Retry and Show solution)
fields.description: Shared style for Check, Try again and Show solution buttons. Border colors apply only when border is enabled.

fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.label: Button border radius
fields.description: Default is 2em (Joubel UI). Lower values are sharper; higher values are more rounded.

fields.label: Clue answer fields
fields.description: Text fields where the answers are typed next to each clue.

fields.label: Correct answer colors
fields.description: Used in the grid cells and in the clue list once the answer is checked.

fields.label: Wrong answer colors
fields.description: Used in the grid cells and in the clue list once the answer is checked.

fields.label: Missing answer colors
fields.description: Used for cells and characters that were left empty.

fields.label: Solution word
fields.description: Strip of cells that spells the solution word below the grid.

fields.label: Marker circle color
fields.description: Circle that marks the cells of the grid taking part in the solution word.

fields.label: Extra clue window
fields.description: Window that opens with the extra clue of a word.

fields.label: Scrollbar
fields.description: Colors for the scrollbar of the clue list.

fields.label: Scrollbar width
fields.description: Width in pixels.

fields.label: Show scrollbar track
fields.description: When enabled, the track behind the scrollbar thumb is visible and its color can be configured.

semantics.label: Veikimo nuostatos
semantics.description: Šios parinktys leis jums valdyti, kaip veikia užduotis.

fields.label: Rodomų žodžių skaičius
fields.description: Create a randomized batch of words from the pool. The batch will always contain at least all the words that were fixed on the grid regardless of this setting. An empty value or 0 means to use all words.

fields.label: Submit automatically when everything is correct
fields.description: If this option is enabled, filling the grid correctly will submit the answer without pressing the check button.

fields.label: Score words
fields.description: If this option is enabled, words will be counted in order to determine the score. Otherwise, correct characters will be counted.

fields.label: Taikyti nuobaudas
fields.description: Jei ši parinktis įjungta, už kiekvieną neteisingą atsakymą bus skiriama bauda -1.

fields.label: Keep correct answers on retry
fields.description: If this option is enabled, correct answers will be kept when the user retries the task unless full score was achieved.

fields.label: Cannot create crossword
fields.default: Could not generate a crossword with the given words. Please try again with fewer words or words that have more characters in common.

fields.label: Cannot create crossword (too few words)
fields.default: Could not generate a crossword. You need at least two words.

fields.label: Probematic words
fields.description: List words that caused trouble while generating the crossword. @words is a placeholder that will be replaced by the actual problematic words.
fields.default: Some words could not be placed. If you are using fixed words, please make sure that their position doesn't prevent other words from being placed. Words with the same alignment may not be placed touching each other. Problematic word(s): @words

fields.label: Crossword grid description
fields.default: Crossword grid. Use arrow keys to navigate and keyboard to enter characters. Use tab to use input fields instead.

fields.description: Result announcer. @clue is a variable and will be replaced by the respective clue.
fields.label: Result for

fields.description: Solution announcer. @clue and @solution are variables and will be replaced by the respective values.
fields.label: Solution for

fields.description: Extra clue announcer. @clue is a variable and will be replaced by the respective value.
fields.label: Extra clue for

fields.description: Announcing the current position. @position and @length are variables and will be replaced by their respective values.
fields.label: Letter

fields.description: Announcing the word length. @length is a variable and will be replaced by the respective value.
fields.label: Žodžio ilgis
Assistive technology description for "Check" button
fields.default: Check the characters. The responses will be marked as correct, incorrect, or unanswered.

fields.label: Mygtuko „Rodyti sprendimą“ pagalbinės technologijos aprašymas
fields.default: Show the solution. The crossword will be filled with its correct solution.

fields.label: Assistive technology description for "Retry" button
fields.default: Retry the task. Reset all responses and start the task over again.

fields.label: Jūsų rezultatas
fields.description: @score and @total are variables and will be replaced by their respective values.
